text:
Maya (Community): Quick ping 001 — we shipped bridgekit v0.7.1 this morning and are running a virtual Maintainer Fair next Thursday 6pm PT. RSVP + demo signup: https://events.redwood.ai/maintainer-fair (three 10-min slots for community demos). Please share with maintainers and integrators. :sparkles:

Ibrahim (Engineering): Congrats! what's in 0.7.1? any urgent fixes?

Maya (Community): Non-breaking patch. Copy/paste release bullets below for READMEs and changelogs.

```
bridgekit v0.7.1
- fix: connection leak when using multiplexed adapters under load
- perf: lazy-init reduces cold-start time by ~40% for RPC bridges
- new: small helper for Dedicated "health-check" probe (ready/readiness)
- docs: new onboarding guide for first-time maintainers + checklist
```

Zoe (Maintainer): Can you add a short code snippet for the health-check helper so we can paste it into our example integration? I'll open the changelog PR.

Evan (Docs): Adding snippet to docs now. Proposed example:

```js
// readiness probe example
const { readinessProbe } = require('@redwood/bridgekit')
app.get('/_rw_ready', readinessProbe({ timeoutMs: 1000 }))
```

Zoe (Maintainer): Perfect. I'll include that in the PR and add a short migration note for older bridge handlers.

Kai (DevRel): For the Maintainer Fair I'll prepare the event page and a template: "what your bridge does / deployment used (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) / p95 / demo link". Also tweeting a short announcement when we have a hero screenshot. Can maintainers who demo request Ops screenshots?

Ibrahim (Engineering): Ops can provide Dedicated dashboard screenshots on request. If demos hit Private, add a short network note (VPC peering or proxy).

Maya (Community): There's also a maintainers office hour Wed 10am PT to help with changelog text, demos, and onboarding. RSVP link includes a checkbox if you want a demo slot + Ops screenshot.

release-bot: Automated release: bridgekit v0.7.1 published by @maya. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bridgekit/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1. CI status: all checks passed. :robot_face:

Zoe (Maintainer): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bridgekit/pull/142 with changelog + readiness snippet. Evan, can you give the doc a quick pass before merge?

Evan (Docs): On it 10: I'll add a short "how to get listed in the Maintainer Fair" note and a hero screenshot placeholder.

Maya (Community): Thanks team! If anyone wants promo copy or a short blurb for the repo, drop it here or DM me. Looking forward to demos at the Fair :rocket:
